description: Rolls dice for a Plot Speaks campaign or adventure on the server: "1d20+5", "2d6", "adv 1d20+3" (advantage), "dis 1d20" (disadvantage), "4d6 drop lowest". Returns each die and the total.

hidden.description: True for a roll the story's rules keep secret from the players (a world clock, a hidden table); the result comes with a note that it is hidden and not for reading aloud

why.description: What the roll is for, e.g. Mira's stealth check

name: roll
title: Roll dice
